name: Peak Bio-Clean
tagline: Biohazard, Crime Scene & Trauma Cleanup in Florida — 24/7

colors.name: Primary Blue
colors.use: Primary brand color — buttons, links, headers

voice.summary: Calm, competent, human. We show up for people on the worst day of their life — the tone is compassionate first, professional second, never clinical or cold and never sensational.
rules: Lead with reassurance and clarity before credentials — people want to know it will be handled, then that we're licensed/certified.
Use plain language, short sentences. No jargon without explaining it.
Always emphasize: 24/7 availability, discretion, compassion, and that we work directly with insurance.
Name the real situation plainly but respectfully (crime scene, unattended death, hoarding, biohazard) — don't euphemism it into vagueness, but don't sensationalize it either.
First person plural ('we', 'our team') — Peak Bio-Clean shows up as a team, not a faceless company.
Every post should answer 'why would someone trust us with this' without being salesy about it.
Before/after content: focus on relief and restoration, not shock value.
avoid: emojis stacked more than 2-3 per caption

captions.formula: Hook (the real situation, 1 line) → What we did / what changed (2-3 lines) → Reassurance + CTA (24/7 line, phone number or link)
